changeSet.sql:
create or alter function [api].[ShouldAllowNewBatchCall] ( @executionID uniqueidentifier = null ) returns bit AS BEGIN declare @runningCount int = 0; declare @earliestDate datetime = DATEADD(day, -1, GETDATE()) -- Time after which you can check for ACTIVE job runs.
-- never ran a batch api execution if ( not exists (select 1 from api.execution)) begin return 1; end
-- all jobs have completed if ( not exists (select 1 from api.execution where completedOn is null)) begin return 1; end
-- all the jobs that have not completed are older than 24 hours -- all jobs have completed if ( not exists (select 1 from api.execution where completedOn is null and startedon > @earliestDate ) ) begin return 1; end
-- find count of jobs that have been running for 24 hours or less, have not completed, and have not erred out. select @runningCount = count(1) from api.Execution where CompletedOn is null and ProcessingStartedOn > @earliestDate and ErrorMessage is null if (@runningCount > 3) begin return 0; end
--all other checks have passed. make sure there are no other jobs with the same asset/intersect type running if (@executionID is not null) begin
--don't consider any execution older than 24 hrs if exists (select 1 from api.Execution where ExecutionID = @executionID and StartedOn < @earliestDate) begin return 0; end
--find type uid declare @typeUid uniqueidentifier = null; declare @type varchar(25) = null;
select @typeUid = f.AssetTypeUid, @type = 'asset' from api.Execution E outer apply openjson(e.Fields) with (AssetTypeUid uniqueidentifier '$.AssetTypeUid') f where E.ExecutionID = @executionID and e.Fields is not null and e.Fields like '%AssetTypeUid%';
select @typeUid = f.IntersectTypeUid, @type = 'intersect' from api.Execution E outer apply openjson(e.Fields) with (IntersectTypeUid uniqueidentifier '$.IntersectTypeUid') f where E.ExecutionID = @executionID and e.Fields is not null and e.Fields like '%IntersectTypeUid%';
if (@typeUid is not null) begin if (@type = 'asset') begin if exists( select 1 from api.execution e outer apply openjson(e.Fields) with (AssetTypeUid uniqueidentifier '$.AssetTypeUid') f where e.MarkedForProcessing = 1 and (@executionID is null or e.executionID <> @executionID) and e.Fields is not null and e.Fields like '%AssetTypeUid%' and e.completedOn is null and e.startedon > @earliestDate and e.ErrorMessage is null and f.AssetTypeUid = @typeUid) begin return 0; end end if (@type = 'intersect') begin if exists( select 1 from api.execution e outer apply openjson(e.Fields) with (IntersectTypeUid uniqueidentifier '$.IntersectTypeUid') f where e.MarkedForProcessing = 1 and (@executionID is null or e.executionID <> @executionID) and e.Fields is not null and e.Fields like '%IntersectTypeUid%' and e.completedOn is null and e.startedon > @earliestDate and e.ErrorMessage is null and f.IntersectTypeUid = @typeUid) begin return 0; end end end end
-- Return the result of the function RETURN 1; END
